seo.title: Carton Blank Size Calculator — Boxes Per Sheet & Board Cost
seo.desc: Calculate RSC (FEFCO 0201) carton blank width and height from inner dimensions, then how many blanks fit on a corrugated sheet and the board cost per box.

hint.en: Thickness used to convert inner to manufacturing size.
hint.zh: 用于内尺寸→制造尺寸换算的纸板厚度。

hint.en: Added twice on each direction for die-cut grip and paper edges.
hint.zh: 每个方向加两次，用于模切叼口与毛边。

hint.en: Your corrugator's deckle width — the hard limit.

howP.en: FEFCO 0201 is the regular slotted container: one piece, four panels, two flaps each end. Its flat blank is 2×(length+width) plus the glue lap long, and height+width deep because the two flaps are each half the width. Converting inner to manufacturing size adds one board thickness per panel direction. Trim and flap gap are shop variables — set them to your die, not to mine.
howP.zh: FEFCO 0201 就是最常见的开槽箱：一张纸板、四块箱面、两端各两片摇盖。展开长 = 2×(长+宽) + 接舌，展开宽 = 高 + 宽（两片摇盖各占半个宽）。内尺寸转制造尺寸时每个方向加一个纸厚。修边和摇盖间隙是车间变量，请按你们自己的刀模改，别用我的默认值。

q.en: Why is the blank height height + width, not height + 2 widths?
q.zh: 为什么展开宽是 高+宽，不是 高+2宽？

a.en: Because each end has two flaps and they meet in the middle. Top flap depth is width/2, bottom flap depth is width/2, so together they consume exactly one width of board. Subtract the flap gap to keep them from overlapping.
a.zh: 因为两端各两片摇盖，在中线对接。上摇盖深度 = 宽/2，下摇盖深度 = 宽/2，两片合起来正好占一个宽度。减去摇盖间隙是为了不让它们顶在一起。

a.en: Yes — pick BC (7 mm) or AB (8 mm). The thickness only enters through the manufacturing-size conversion, so a wrong flute choice shifts every dimension by a millimetre or two.
a.zh: 能，选 BC（7mm）或 AB（8mm）。纸厚只影响制造尺寸换算这一步，坑型选错会让每个尺寸差一两毫米。

q.en: Why does rotating the blank sometimes give one more per sheet?
q.zh: 为什么横竖换一下，出数会多一个？

a.en: Because board width is the hard constraint. If your blank is 690 wide on a 1400 sheet, two across leaves 20 mm of waste; rotating may let three fit the other way. The tool tries both and keeps the better one.
a.zh: 因为幅宽是硬约束。展开宽 690 放在 1400 幅宽上，两个并排剩 20mm 废料；转 90° 可能另一边能塞三个。工具两种都算，取多的那个。

q.en: Is the board cost accurate enough to quote from?
q.zh: 这个纸钱能直接拿去报价吗？

a.en: It is the raw board cost per box before waste at the corrugator and before your converting loss. Most shops add 3–8% depending on run length. Use it as the floor, not the final number.
a.zh: 这是单箱原纸成本，不含瓦线损耗和你的后道损耗。多数厂按批量加 3–8%。把它当成下限，不是最终报价。
